p.m.

Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.

4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-10-21 Item 8A - Warrants
8B.
Contract with Statewide Stripes, Inc., to provide citywide street striping and marking services. Contact Person: Deputy Director Hosford
Authorize the Public Works Director, or his designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to enter into a contract with Statewide Stripes, Inc., for a two-year original term contract with options to extend for two, two-year additional terms, not to exceed a total of six years and in the amount not to exceed the approved budget.
2015-10-21 Item 8B - Striping and Marking Services Contract
8C.
County of San Diego Neighborhood Reinvestment Program grant in the amount of $16,400 for cultural arts programs. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Authorize the Arts Administrator to submit a grant application for the County of San Diego Neighborhood Reinvestment Program.
2015-10-21 Item 8C - Neighborhood Reinvestment Program Grant
8D.
Construction contract and budget adjustment for the El Camino Real Channel Improvement Project (CD06D). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
1) Authorize the Public Works Director, to execute a contract, and any necessary extensions, with Whillock Contracting in the amount of $966,507 plus 15% contingencies to construct the El Camino Real Channel Improvement Project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $1,111,483; 2) Authorize the Public Works Director, to execute a contract amendment, and any necessary extensions, with Dudek & Associates, Inc. ("Dudek") in the amount of $21,000 to provide revegetation construction monitoring services during construction, for a total contract amount not to exceed $107,170; 3) Authorize the Public Works Director, to execute a contract amendment, and any necessary extensions, with Rick Engineering Co. in the amount of $48,979.25 to provide additional construction staking and storm water inspection services necessary to complete the construction of the project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $136,429.25; and, 4) Adopt Resolution 2015-67, Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget, authorizing an additional appropriation of $500,000.
2015-10-21 Item 8D - El Camino Real Improvement Project

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
